tool_calls.name: pwsh
tool_calls.arguments_from_deltas: {"command": "$months=1..6; $rev=@(1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000); $cost=@(700,1400,2100,2800,3500,4200); $TR=($rev|Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $TC=($cost|Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $P=$TR-$TC; $M=[math]::Round($P/$TR*100,1); \"TOTAL=$TR COST=$TC PROFIT=$P MARGIN=$M%\"; for($i=0;$i -lt 6;$i++){ $m=$rev[$i]-$cost[$i]; \"{0}月 收入${1} 成本${2} 利润${3} 利润率{4}%\" -f ($i+1),$rev[$i],$cost[$i],$m,[math]::Round($m/$rev[$i]*100,1) }", "description": "内存计算逐月及汇总收入成本利润"}
tool_calls.final_arguments: {"command": "$months=1..6; $rev=@(1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000); $cost=@(700,1400,2100,2800,3500,4200); $TR=($rev|Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $TC=($cost|Measure-Object -Sum).Sum; $P=$TR-$TC; $M=[math]::Round($P/$TR*100,1); \"TOTAL=$TR COST=$TC PROFIT=$P MARGIN=$M%\"; for($i=0;$i -lt 6;$i++){ $m=$rev[$i]-$cost[$i]; \"{0}月 收入${1} 成本${2} 利润${3} 利润率{4}%\" -f ($i+1),$rev[$i],$cost[$i],$m,[math]::Round($m/$rev[$i]*100,1) }", "description": "内存计算逐月及汇总收入成本利润"}
